info.title: CEES AI Service Internal API
info.description:
Internal infrastructure API used only by trusted CEES services.
Desktop, mobile, and third-party clients must call the NestJS public API instead.

post.description:
Streams Server-Sent Events in this order: `started`, zero or more
`content_delta` events, an optional `usage` event, and `completed`.
If a provider fails after streaming starts, an `error` event terminates
the stream. Each SSE `data` field contains one `StreamEvent` JSON object.
Generates one assistant response from trusted instructions, an optional prior summary, and ordered recent messages.

example.instructions: Answer as a concise enterprise assistant.

content.text: Our project is named CEES AI.

post.description:
Streams `started`, optional `status`, zero or more `content_delta`,
an optional `usage`, and `completed`. An `error` event terminates a
stream after the initial response has started. No provider reasoning
content is exposed.

post.summary: Stream a single tool-capable chat turn
post.description:
Performs exactly one model turn. The stream emits normal `content_delta`
events when the assistant answers directly, or a `tool_calls` event when
the model requests tool execution. ai-service never executes tools; the
caller must perform the tool and call this endpoint again with the
resulting ToolMessage.

post.summary: Compact conversation history into a reusable summary
post.description: Produces a summary for the caller to persist and supply with later chat requests. The ai-service does not persist conversation state.

post.summary: Generate an image through a configured image-capable model
post.description:
Generates an image for a trusted internal caller. ai-service only
returns image bytes and execution metadata; it does not persist the
image, create a resource, or enforce business quota.

post.summary: Edit an image while preserving the source image
post.description:
Edits an existing source image using a configured image-capable model.
The source image is supplied as base64 in the JSON request body. ai-service
only returns the edited image bytes and execution metadata; it does not
persist the image or create a resource.

get.summary: Preview a generated image as raw bytes
get.description:
Convenience endpoint that returns the generated image bytes directly so
the image can be viewed in a browser tab. It does not persist anything
and does not return execution metadata.

parameters.name: token
parameters.description: Internal token for direct browser preview. Prefer the X-AI-Internal-Token header; this query parameter exists only so the image can be opened in a plain browser tab without custom headers.

post.summary: Extract plain text from a document
post.description: Deterministically extracts plain text from uploaded file bytes without invoking an LLM. Supports plain text, Markdown, CSV, JSON, DOCX, PPTX, XLSX, and best-effort PDF. Returns MessageContentPart items ready for chat context assembly.

Builds TextNodes from a normalized ParsedDocument, chunks them,
embeds them, and idempotently upserts the vectors into the vector
store. Replacement is keyed by the (tenant_id, document_version_id,
index_version) triple: re-submitting the same triple replaces the
previous nodes instead of duplicating them. chunking_version and
embedding_profile are recorded as node metadata and define the index
identity; changing either requires a new index_version. ai-service
never writes the business database and does not create formal
resources.

post.summary: Delete derived index of a document version
post.description:
Deletes all derived vectors of the given (document_version_id,
index_version) tuple for the tenant. NestJS calls this when a
document is deleted or when a new document version supersedes the
old one. Never touches business data; deleting the derived index
does not delete the business document.

post.summary: Retrieve knowledge chunks within a trusted scope
post.description:
Embeds the query and returns the most similar chunks whose metadata
satisfies the caller-supplied trusted scope. Scope filtering is applied
during the vector query, not after a global top-k. This endpoint does
not invoke an LLM; answer generation is a separate capability.

example.query: What is the escalation procedure for delayed projects?

200.description: Chunks retrieved within the trusted scope

post.summary: Answer a question grounded in retrieved knowledge chunks
post.description:
Retrieves chunks within the trusted scope, then generates a grounded
answer with the rag role. An empty retrieval short-circuits without an
LLM call and returns insufficient_evidence=true. The model only outputs
citation ids (S1..Sn assigned to the retrieved chunks in order); the
service maps them back to real chunk origins, so the model can never
fabricate document ids, page numbers or urls.

internalToken.name: X-AI-Internal-Token
internalToken.description: Internal token issued to trusted CEES services. Do not expose it to clients.

chat_context_budgets.description: 各聊天模式的输入 Token 预算（config/models.toml 的 chat.modes.*.context_budget_tokens）。调用方在组装上下文前据此决定 是否触发历史压缩，避免与 ai-service 的模型调用前裁剪上限漂移。

KnowledgeIndexStatus.description: 知识库向量索引的运行时身份。NestJS 的索引 Worker 据此判断「已标 READY 的 文档其向量是否仍然存在」：`durable=false` 表示索引只活在 ai-service 进程内， 进程重启即全部丢失，此时 `epoch` 变化即代表索引已被清空，必须把文档重新排队 重建，否则检索会静默返回空结果而文档仍显示 READY。

durable.description: 索引是否跨进程重启持久化。memory 后端为 false。

epoch.description: 索引实例标识。同一进程内恒定、重启后变化；持久化后端固定为 "persistent"。

url.description: Image URL or data URL containing the encoded image.

finish_reason.description: Provider completion reason. `length` indicates the output token limit was reached.

instructions.description: Trusted system instructions supplied by the internal caller.

conversation_summary.description: Summary of history preceding the supplied recent messages.

user_memories.description: Long-term user memories, each a self-contained statement about the user. Injected as a dedicated system block before the conversation summary; absent or null means no memories are injected. At most 30 entries.

UserMemoryType.description: Memory type. PREFERENCE personal preference, FACT personal fact, DECISION a decision the user made, HABIT a working habit.

content.description: A self-contained statement about the user, quoted from the conversation; no inference, no team-level information, no sensitive data.

action.description: create adds a new memory; update corrects an existing one and must be paired with `replaces`.

replaces.description: When action is update: a key phrase copied verbatim from the existing memory being replaced. Only meaningful when the existing memories are injected in the context.

memory_candidates.description: Long-term memory candidates extracted alongside the summary; empty when nothing is worth remembering.

finish_reason.description: Provider completion reason. `length` indicates the output token limit was reached.

related_questions.description: Short follow-up questions derived from the final reply; each at most 30 characters. Only present on the completed event of the stream that produced the final user-facing answer; absent when the reply contained no follow-up suggestions.

memory_candidates.description: Long-term memory candidates derived from the final reply. Only present on the completed event of the stream that produced the final user-facing answer; absent when the user expressed nothing worth remembering or the turn called tools.

parameters.description: JSON Schema for the tool arguments; root must be an object.

ToolTurnMessage.description:
A single message in a tool-capable turn. `user` messages have `content`.
`assistant` messages may have `content` and/or `tool_calls`. `tool`
messages must have `tool_call_id` and `content`.

user_memories.description: Long-term user memories, each a self-contained statement about the user. Injected as a dedicated system block before the conversation summary; absent or null means no memories are injected. At most 30 entries.

size.description: Requested image size as WIDTHxHEIGHT in pixels, or "auto" to let the model choose. Accepted values depend on the configured model. This is a hint only; the model may return different dimensions, which are reported in execution.width and execution.height when parseable.

source_image_base64.description: Base64-encoded source image bytes using the standard alphabet. The decoded size must not exceed 10 MiB.

size.description: Requested edited image size as WIDTHxHEIGHT in pixels, or "auto" to let the model choose. This is a hint only; the model may return different dimensions, which are reported in execution.width and execution.height when parseable.

input_fidelity.description: How strongly the edit should preserve the source image. Use "high" for subtle changes such as tone, lighting, or color adjustments.

width.description: Actual image width in pixels when the returned bytes could be parsed.

height.description: Actual image height in pixels when the returned bytes could be parsed.

data_base64.description: Base64-encoded image bytes using the standard alphabet.

generation_mode.description: Fast composes directly; quality creates a reasoning plan before composition.

planning_reasoning_effort.description: DeepSeek reasoning effort used by the quality-mode planning stage.

url.description: Image location the renderer downloads (COS signed URL or data URL). Callers must only pass locations the reader is allowed to see.

alt.description: Alternative text; used as the placeholder label when the image cannot be fetched.

width_ratio.description: Share of the content width the image occupies; height follows the source aspect ratio.

name.description: Excel worksheet name. Reserved characters are rejected.

url.description: COS URL of the image to embed.

finish_reason.description: Provider completion reason. `length` indicates the output token limit was reached.

data_base64.description: Base64-encoded file bytes using the standard alphabet. The decoded size must not exceed 10 MiB.

type.description: Normalized block kind produced by the parser. Unknown parser kinds must be mapped by the caller before submitting.

text.description: Block text when the block carries inline content; null for pure asset blocks.

bbox.description: Page-relative bounding box in reading order [x0, y0, x1, y1].

heading_path.description: Ancestor heading titles from root to the closest heading, in reading order.

acl_version.description: Version of the access-control snapshot the caller used to compute the scope. Retrieval must compare it against the node metadata to avoid serving stale visibility information.

index_version.description: Identity of the index generation. Switching embedding models or chunking strategies creates a new index_version instead of overwriting existing vectors.

document_version_id.description: Identity of the document version whose derived index should be removed. Deleting the derived index never deletes the business document.

deleted_chunks.description: Number of derived nodes removed from the vector store.

allowed_document_ids.description: Optional document-level allowlist computed by the caller. When omitted, all documents inside the given knowledge bases match.

department_ids.description: Optional department allowlist computed by the caller. Only constrains nodes that carry a department_id; nodes without one pass through.

project_ids.description: Optional project allowlist computed by the caller. Only constrains nodes that carry a project_id; nodes without one pass through.

acl_version.description: Optional ACL snapshot identifier of the indexed nodes. When omitted, retrieval does not filter on ACL version. Callers that fold permissions in real time on every request may omit it until ACL versioning or retrieval caching is introduced.

embedding_profile.description: Embedding profile for the query. Null selects the configured default; the effective profile is returned in the response.
Embedding profile for the query. Null selects the configured default; the effective profile is returned in the response.

max_answer_tokens.description: Output token budget for the grounded answer.

citation_id.description: Short citation label referenced by the answer, e.g. S1.

answer.description: Grounded answer text. Empty when insufficient_evidence is true.

grounded.description: True when the answer is backed by mapped citations; always false when insufficient_evidence is true.

insufficient_evidence.description: True when the retrieval produced no chunks or the model determined the evidence cannot answer the question. The service never answers from model imagination in this case.

execution.description: Present only when the rag role actually produced the answer. Null when the empty-retrieval short-circuit skipped the LLM call.
Present only when a model invocation actually completed far enough to report execution and Token metrics before the business result was rejected.
